info.description:
# B2B Rep app (تطبيق المندوب)

Generated **2026-11-03** from `route:list` + catalog. Live routes only.

| | |
|---|---|
| Requests | **65** |
| Environment | `docs/api/environments/rep-android.postman_environment.json` |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Seed | public OTP → kind rep — local code 0000 when bypass |

Import this file **and** the matching environment. `baseUrl` is the host only (no `/api/v1`).
Do not mix tokens across platform / channel / warehouse collections.

Contract briefs: `docs/DocsLast/rep.md` · order flow: `docs/DocsLast/order-flow.md`

Regenerate: `php docs/api/generate-dashboard-postman.php`

request.description:
**EP-CORE-001**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | فحص الصحة |

Public liveness. No tenant, no auth.

**EP-PB-011**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | انترو التطبيق |

Same singleton the platform back office edits (EP-AD-141A/B). No auth — first-run splash before OTP. Vacant store is enabled:false. Apps must not call /platform/content/intro or /channel/content/intro (wrong_guard). Targeting is ignored on first run (no zone yet). media_id is an opaque string, not a URL, until media upload exists.

**EP-CM-001**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | **exempt** |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | طلب رمز واتساب |

purpose: register|login. Rate: 3/hour per phone, 10/hour per device, 30/hour per IP (REQ-CM-055). Phone E.164 Syrian mobile.

**EP-CM-003**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | **exempt** |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | إعادة إرسال الرمز |

prefer_channel: whatsapp|sms. Falls back to SMS if WhatsApp fails.

**EP-CM-002**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | **exempt** |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تحقق رمز الدخول |

5 attempts per otp_id. New user returns is_new_user=true without a full profile.

**EP-PB-001**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | المرجعيات العامة للتسجيل |

Registration screens cache this locally and refresh by cursor (REQ-AD-032, REQ-CM-016).

**EP-CM-005**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | خروج التطبيق |

Client must wipe local data (REQ-CM-056).

**EP-CM-004**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | جلسة الإقلاع |

Called on every launch (REQ-CM-004). Distinguishes new vs returning users (TB-RT-011). requires_legal_accept blocks usage until consent (DOC-12E TB-AD-081). user.avatar is always null until media upload. Reps also receive commercial_limits, duty {on_duty, tracking_enabled}, status (profile: pending_review|active|rejected|disabled), and channel {id, name|null} (BF-06).

**EP-APP-040**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | العروض |

company (channel identity) stays hidden until an order is confirmed (REQ-IN-06).

**EP-APP-041**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تفاصيل عرض |

Re-validate via quote before submit (TB-RT-043).

**EP-APP-030**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تسعير الخادم |

Single source of truth (REQ-IN-07). Precedence stop-at-first-match (most specific wins; lists do not stack): retailer_price ← group_list ← zone_list ← qty_tier ← base_price. Clients must not send prices. gross is the sum of unit_price × qty (السعر). discount is the sum of line discounts (الخصم). subtotal is gross − discount (الإجمالي). All three are integers in minor units.

**EP-CM-063**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | رمز الإشعارات |

**EP-CM-060**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | الإشعارات |

meta.unread_count is included in the envelope.

**EP-CM-062**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | مسح عرض الإشعارات |

Clears the inbox view, not the server log.

**EP-CM-061**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تعليم الكل كمقروء |

**EP-SY-001**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | سحب المزامنة |

Retailer scopes: catalog,pricing,offers,zones,orders,refs. Rep extra: rep_catalog,customers,zones,assignments,deliveries,wallet. If cursor is too old, full_resync_required=true.

**EP-SY-002**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | دفع المزامنة |

Max 500 ops per batch, 20/min per device. status: applied|duplicate|conflict|failed. Device never pushes catalog/prices/offers/stock (REQ-CM-017). Allowed: order, payment, delivery, receipt, shortage, favorite, rating, add-shop.

**EP-SY-004**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | حل تعارض |

Client must not drop an op from the outbox until applied or duplicate (REQ-CM-019).

**EP-SY-003**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | حالة المزامنة |

**EP-APP-101**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تسجيل نقرة بانر |

Atomic clicks++ on a Banner the caller can see (covering channels). Foreign or unknown id → 404.

**EP-APP-100**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | بلوكات الرئيسية |

Filtered by the user activity type and zone, including intro targeting (TB-RT-010). Serving a Banner row increments impressions atomically.

**EP-APP-110**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | النقاط |

**EP-APP-111**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | استبدال نقاط |

**EP-RP-001**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | إكمال تسجيل المندوب |

Channel must be active; zones must be inside its coverage (TB-RP-010). No email field — reps authenticate by Syrian mobile only.

**EP-RP-022**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | سلة المندوب |

One card per shop. Every section is a draft (مسودة) until submit removes it. retailer.zone is the shop zone name. temp_order_no is the draft reference shown as رقم الفاتورة; logo is always null. total is the payable amount in minor units. The on-device banner is the local outbox, not this payload.

**EP-RP-021**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | إضافة لسلة محل |

Same shape as GET /cart. qty increments an existing (product, variant) line. PATCH/DELETE the line via EP-RP-025/026. temp_order_no is the draft reference (رقم الفاتورة while the section is still a cart). It is not an issued invoice.

**EP-RP-025**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تعديل كمية سطر سلة محل |

Same cart shape as GET /cart. qty 0 deletes the line (same as EP-RP-026).

**EP-RP-026**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | حذف سطر سلة محل |

Same cart shape as GET /cart. 404 if the line is not on this rep cart.

**EP-RP-023**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | إرسال طلب محل |

discount_percent must be ≤ the rep cap (BR-12). status pending is بانتظار الموافقة. gross is the struck-through amount, total is the payable amount, both minor units. invoice_no is null until finance issues one — show sub_order_no in the رقم الفاتورة row. تابع حالة الطلب reads GET /app/rep/orders by id.

**EP-RP-030**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.accept` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | إسنادات بانتظار القبول |

Pending assignments only, so every card is «بانتظار قبولك» and the badge count is the array length. total is payable minor units. lines are the order lines behind «تفاصيل الفاتورة» — invoice_no stays null until finance, so the card number is sub_order_no. Accept moves the card to deliveries (REQ-IN-03).

**EP-RP-031**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.accept` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | قبول الإسناد |

**EP-RP-032**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.accept` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | رفض الإسناد |

Returns to unassigned + immediate channel alert (REQ-IN-03).

**EP-RP-033**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.accept` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | الطلبات المجدولة |

Postponed only, so the badge «مواعيد قادمة» is the array length and every card is مؤجل. اليوم / غداً / هذا الأسبوع filter scheduled_at on the client (omit date to take the whole list). The card number is invoice_no or else sub_order_no. تاريخ الطلب is created_at. The appointment is scheduled_at. A delivered order leaves this list.

**EP-PB-010**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `none` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | إعداد التطبيق وفحص النسخة |

Called on every app launch (REQ-AD-073, 074). Stale X-App-Version → 426.

**EP-RP-040**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.warehouse.receive` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | استلام العهدة |

Handovers the warehouse already opened. count is orders (عدد الطلبات). item_count and items[] are the shelf list: same product+variant summed, qty under sale_unit, variant as the subtitle. Search is local. One orders[] element is the custody-match sheet (shop, number, lines, total). parties.warehouse is confirmed because opening the handover was the warehouse signature; parties.rep stays pending until EP-RP-041. invoice_no is null until finance — show order_no. Pass ?date= so the date tile matches the list.

**EP-RP-041**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.warehouse.receive` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تأكيد استلام العهدة |

temp_code is the 4 digits the warehouse shows; the confirm button collects it. Stock is deducted and status becomes on_the_way only when BOTH EP-WH-019 and this confirm exist (REQ-IN-02). That is this response: both parties are confirmed, so the screen does not stay on «بانتظار مسؤول المستودع». Replay of an already-confirmed handover returns the same body. «تسجيل اختلاف في الكمية» has no write on this path.

**EP-RP-050**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.deliver` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | قائمة التسليم |

Zone chips are zones[]: id, name, and total as the badge. The line «تم تسليم N من M» is that zone's delivered and total. Card amount is total. The card number is invoice_no when finance has issued one, otherwise sub_order_no. accepted and on_the_way both read «بانتظار التسليم».

**EP-RP-051**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.deliver` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تفاصيل التسليم |

The sheet header is shop plus sub_order_no while invoice_no is null. The green line amount is line_total; price stays the unit price. «تعديل كمية» is EP-RP-052 action=adjust. «طلب إرجاع / استبدال» is EP-RP-057. «أكد استلام الطلب» is EP-RP-053. «تأجيل أو تعذر» is EP-RP-054 or EP-RP-055. lat/lng open the map; both null means the shop has no pin. scheduled_at is the appointment only after a postpone — there is no computed ETA.

**EP-RP-053**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.deliver` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | إنهاء التسليم |

Success sheet: shop and delivered_at under the title, invoice.total as the amount. ask_payment opens collection with this receipt_no and invoice — do not reserve a second receipt. Delivery is not collection. 409 illegal_transition when the order is not yet on_the_way and the handover is unconfirmed. An order already on_the_way can be finished.

**EP-RP-055**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.deliver` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تعذر التسليم |

The status dropdown is this call: the order becomes undelivered. reason is the required dropdown value. note is the details field and is appended to reason, capped at 255. «أبقِ الطلب دون تغيير» dismisses the sheet and sends nothing. The warning copy is static.

**EP-RP-052**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.deliver` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تعديل بند التسليم |

action: adjust|return|exchange. Updates the invoice on both sides in the same transaction (REQ-IN-05).

**EP-RP-054**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.postpone` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تأجيل التسليم |

Date and time are one scheduled_at. note, when present, is appended to reason (the column holds both, capped at 255). The card then appears on GET /scheduled-orders. «إلغاء التسليم» on this sheet is EP-RP-055, not this route.

**EP-RP-056**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | نبضات الموقع |

Batched pings, on-duty only. Rate: 1/30s per rep (REQ-CM-044).

**EP-RP-057**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.delivery.return_request` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | طلب إرجاع ميداني |

type return|exchange. The product picker is the delivery lines (line_id is the delivery line id). Reason is one string, max 255 — the dropdown value and the extra note are joined by the client. photos stay []. status pending is «بانتظار موافقة قناة التوريد». There is no later read for the rep; keep request_no on the device. The invoice does not change until the channel accepts.

**EP-CM-050**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.payment.collect` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | حجز رقم وصل |

Server-generated unique number BEFORE payment starts (REQ-IN-01). Used by EP-RP-060 then EP-RT-050.

**EP-RP-060**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.payment.collect` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تحصيل دفعة |

receipt_no must be reserved first via EP-CM-050, or taken from EP-RP-053 — do not reserve a second one after complete. client_op_id makes retries duplicate-safe (REQ-IN-01). invoice_no is optional: omitted, the oldest open invoice for this shop and rep is allocated FIFO and the response names that invoice. No open invoice → 404. The receipt sheet is this body: amount, invoice_no, invoice_remaining on that invoice, wallet_balance, paid_at, shop. Shops come from GET /customers. Open invoices for the picker come from GET /receivables.

**EP-RP-064**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.wallet.view` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | ذمم المحلات |

total is the sum of by_shop totals (إجمالي الذمم). Partial is paid > 0 and remaining > 0, decided on the device. No PDF.

**EP-RP-061**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.wallet.view` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | المحفظة |

net_balance == SUM(collected) − SUM(settled) at all times (AC-06). The four money tiles are stats.invoiced_total, collected_total, handed_over (SUM of settled), and receivables. invoices_delivered and today.invoices stay counts. today is the Damascus day only. No PDF.

**EP-RP-062**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.payment.withdraw` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تسليم نقدية |

operation_no comes from the accountant and must stay unique across sync retries (TB-RP-063). The success sheet is this body: amount is what was handed over, operated_at is the Damascus time, remaining_balance is the wallet left. «افتح كشف التسليمات» is GET /wallet/withdrawals. There is no PDF.

**EP-RP-063**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Permission | `rp.wallet.view` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | سجل التسليمات |

**EP-RP-074**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | حساب المندوب الشهري |

month is YYYY-MM, Damascus, default the current month. orders_completed counts this rep's sub-orders created in the month whose status is delivered. orders_undelivered counts undelivered the same way. customers_added counts shops this rep sourced in the month. execution_rate is the integer percent completed / (completed + undelivered), null when that sum is 0. Points stay on GET /app/loyalty and are lifetime, not monthly.

**EP-RP-013**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | علامات المندوب |

Active brands on the rep channels, for the filter dropdown. Send the chosen id as filter[brand_id] on GET /products.

**EP-RP-012**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | الفئات الفرعية للمندوب |

The subcategory dropdown. root_category_id is a public root from GET /public/refs. Rows are active channel categories directly under that root. Omit the query and the list is empty. Deeper children are included when filter[category_id] is applied on the product list.

**EP-RP-070A**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | زبائن المندوب |

Shops the rep sourced plus active shops in assigned zones. id is retailer_id. logo is always null. is_open is always true until a hours table exists, so «مغلق» cannot be shown. last_order_at is always null, so «الأكثر زيارة» has no rank. «جديد» sorts on created_at.

**EP-RP-070B**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | required |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | إضافة محل |

Stored locally and synced with a unique client_op_id (TB-RP-053). address, category_ids and equipment_ids are optional.

**EP-RP-070C**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تفاصيل محل |

404 if the shop is not sourced by this rep and not an active shop in their zones. receivable is this rep's open remainder at the shop, minor units, 0 when none. lat/lng are the map pin. Distance is device GPS. There is no ETA.

**EP-RP-002**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | رئيسية المندوب |

Morning snapshot the home screen binds. Counts only — does not call GET /deliveries (that list materialises rows). avatar is always null until media upload. loyalty is the EP-APP-110 snapshot (points 0 / bronze when the wallet is empty). unread_notifications is meta.unread_count of EP-CM-060. collected_today is integer minor units. 401 without a bearer — guest browse is local, not a token.

**EP-RP-024**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | طلبات المندوب |

Sub-orders this rep submitted (rep_id is set on submit) or was later assigned. invoice_no is null until finance issues one.

**EP-RP-010**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | منتجات المندوب |

Union of all channels the rep belongs to. variants[] is empty when the SKU has no active combinations (disabled omitted). image is null until media is attached. sale_unit is the unit name (null when unset); the detail replaces it with {id, name}. created_at is the default -created_at order, so «منتجات جديدة» is this list. has_offer is true when an active offer matches the rep zone and activity — split «العروض» on the device. There is no sales rank, so «الأكثر مبيعاً» has no badge. availability is a word (in_stock|low|out_of_stock), never a carton count. filter[root_category_id] keeps products whose category sits under that public root. filter[category_id] keeps that subcategory and its children. filter[available_only]=1 drops tracked products with no available units and keeps untracked products. filter[offer_only] is not applied. The channel dropdown is GET /app/session channel. Subcategories are GET /app/rep/categories. Brands are GET /app/rep/brands. The picker axes and per-variant price are on GET /products/{id}.

**EP-RP-011**

| | |
|---|---|
| Guard | `app` |
| Idempotency | n/a |
| X-Client | `rep-android` |
| Name | تفاصيل منتج المندوب |

Same isolation as the list. 404 if the product is not in the rep's channel. attributes_map lists a value only when an active variant carries it — do not assume a full cartesian. Match a chip selection by attribute + value. variant.price is the qty-1 unit in minor units (variant override replaces the product base). Strikethrough and percent come from POST /app/pricing/quote as qty changes, not from this payload. Disabled variants are omitted. specs.key «بلد المنشأ» is the origin badge when the channel stored it. unit_factors convert the sale unit (كرتونة × factor = قطعة).

**EP-RP-073**
